decisions.reason: The two-component injection unit was launched only a year ago and its value is still uncertain, and keeping it costs little because it is built on the firm's in-house pumping competence.
This second injection unit overlaps somewhat with A, but a single year of results reveals too little to justify abandoning a cheap option for different resin applications.
Automatic airless guns are standard accessories that fit the core spray business, so keeping this option open costs almost nothing while demand from automated coating lines develops.
A manual airless gun is a staple product that supports sales of pumps and spare parts, so dropping it after one year would forgo value at minimal saving.
The air-assisted airless gun serves finish-quality applications in the firm's markets, and its prospects remain open while the cost of keeping it listed is low.
The data logger is a more uncertain digital option whose demand for quality documentation is still unfolding, so the firm keeps it open rather than abandoning it before results arrive.
